results.title: Is CeeDee Lamb Playing Today? Update on Cowboys WR Injury
results.description: CeeDee Lamb was limited with a quad injury during the game against Tampa Bay, but will that impact his status for the Dallas Cowboys in Week 6?

results.title: Chelsea Keeper Martinez 'Back In A Few Weeks' After Jaw Fracture
results.description: Chelsea goalkeeper Emiliano Martinez said he would be fit to return "in a few weeks" following surgery on a fractured jaw sustained during his team's 2-0 Premier League win at Everton.

results.title: Hyderabad bowled out for 275 after 109-run opening stand against Andhra
results.description: Hyderabad were bowled out for 275 against Andhra on the opening day of their Ranji Trophy Elite Group B match at Mulapadu. After a 109-run opening stand, Andhra’s spinners struck regularly, restricting Hyderabad before the hosts reached nine without loss

results.title: 'Going to Blow Your Minds': Enes Kanter Announces Dream vs. Valkyries Game 3 Plan While Taking a Swipe at Angel Reese & Gabby Williams
results.description: A T-shirt reveal at Game 3 of the WNBA Finals is what Enes Kanter Freedom is promising, and he believes it will leave fans stunned. He already declared for the 2027 WNBA Draft as a vehicle for his views on the league’s transgender eligibility policies, even though he has no chance of playing.

results.title: ‘Hardik Pandya is irreplaceable’, but Sunil Gavaskar backs Naman Dhir as backup all-round option
results.description: Sunil Gavaskar says Hardik Pandya is irreplaceable and backs Naman Dhir as a different all-round option for India after the 2-2 T20I series against West Indies.

results.title: SWDP wins second straight Alaska 9-man high school football state championship
results.description: Student Wrestling Development Program (SWDP) is now a back-to-back Alaska high school football champ. The Archangels beat Kodiak 40-20 in the 9-man championship game Saturday at Redington High School. Saturday marked the end to SWDP’s second year of varsity football. The Archangels are a perfect 17-0 over the last two seasons.
